# Akta

Akta provides company intelligence, enrichment, alternative business signals, news, and targeted company list generation for data-driven workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/akta/.

## Actions

- **Build Company Filters** (read-only): Translate a natural-language company description into reusable structured filters for company-list generation.
- **Generate Company List** (read-only): Generate one caller-controlled offset page of matching companies from exactly one natural-language query or non-empty structured filters…
- **Get Account Status** (read-only): Return the connected Akta account's package, Enterprise entitlement, credit balance, spend, and currency before choosing tier-gated or…
- **Get Company Enrichment** (read-only): Get selected company-data sections as structured JSON or Markdown, or request Akta's fixed concise overview.
- **Get Company Filter Values** (read-only): Resolve allowed label/value choices for one or more fixed-value company-list filters in a single free batch request.
- **Get Company Headcount Trends** (read-only): Return a company's current headcount, monthly history, growth periods, and workforce breakdown by function.
- **Get Company Product Reviews** (read-only): List a company's product catalog when product_ids is omitted, or return detailed ratings and one caller-controlled offset page of reviews…
- **Get Company Website Traffic** (read-only): Return a company's website engagement, monthly visit estimates, and acquisition-source mix.
- **Get News Articles** (read-only): Fetch complete enrichment and full article text for up to 10 Akta news IDs returned by AKTA_SEARCH_NEWS.
- **Get Request Status** (read-only): Get the current state and detail of an asynchronous Akta request, such as a company-addition request.
- **List Company Employee Reviews** (read-only): Return workplace rating aggregates and one explicit offset page of individual employee reviews for an Akta company.
- **List Company Filters** (read-only): List the structured filter fields accepted by company-list generation and identify fields whose values come from fixed lookups, nested…
- **List Company Job Posts** (read-only): Return one explicit offset page of a company's current LinkedIn and Indeed job posts with role details.
- **List Company Social Posts** (read-only): Return one caller-controlled offset page of a company's social posts with content classification and engagement metrics.
- **Request Company Addition**: Submit a missing company for asynchronous addition to Akta.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Resolve a company name, website, or Akta UUID to matching Akta company identities for use with company-data tools.
- **Search Industries** (read-only): Resolve free text to similarity-ranked Akta industry taxonomy codes for company-list and news filters.
- **Search News** (read-only): Search enriched Akta news by company, industry, topic, date, entity, sentiment, quality, and deduplication filters.
- **Search Regions** (read-only): Resolve a region name or UN M49 code to Akta region records, or omit query to list supported regions.
